source.title: 2D Chibi Ninja - 8 Actions
source.author: ashuuya
source.attributionNotice: Feel free to use anywhere you want, be it personal or commercial projects. No credits required, but would be nice.
source.modifications: Cropped the head and shoulders from the original idle/walk sprites, centered each crop in a square transparent canvas, upscaled with nearest-neighbor sampling, and recolored the blue cloth to the listed palette. No third-party characters, franchise marks, or logos were added.
